title: The comparison cycle Y = (S − C) + Ŷ (parent step 2; Simon 7.2.4 with Remark 7.2.5(2))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let F ⊆ ℝ^P be compact and let C, S, Ŷ ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ (m + 1)). Assume that C and S are integer multiplicity (contract IsIntegerMultiplicity), ∂S = ∂C (S.boundary = C.boundary), spt(S − C) ⊆ F, Ŷ is integer multiplicity, ∂Ŷ = 0 and spt Ŷ ⊆ F. Then some Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) is integer multiplicity, has ∂Y = 0, has compact support spt Y ⊆ F, and satisfies Y(ω) = (S − C)(ω) + Ŷ(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(ℝ^P). Here S − C is the contract's difference of currents, (S − C)(ω) = S(ω) − C(ω), and spt is GeometricCurrentOn.support.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid P)) (C S Ŷ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsCompact F → IsIntegerMultiplicity C → IsIntegerMultiplicity S → S.boundary = C.boundary → (S - C).support ⊆ F → IsIntegerMultiplicity Ŷ → Ŷ.boundary = 0 → Ŷ.support ⊆ F → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ Y.boundary = 0 ∧ IsCompact Y.support ∧ Y.support ⊆ F ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Y ω = (S - C) ω + Ŷ ω
